kultivator.formations.disabled: Protective Formations are disabled on this server.
kultivator.formations.incomplete: The Protective Formation is incomplete: %1$s of the 4 Crying Obsidian pillars are missing (marked in red). Each pillar stands 4 blocks from the Lodestone to the north, south, east and west, on the same level. Missing: %2$s
kultivator.formations.not_awakened: The pattern is complete, but the formation still sleeps. Sneak and use the Lodestone while holding an Amethyst Shard to awaken it.
kultivator.formations.owned_by: This Protective Formation belongs to %s. Only its owner can charge it or switch it on and off.
kultivator.formations.awakened: The Protective Formation awakens! Power: %s (each Amethyst Shard adds 10 minutes, up to 2 hours). Monsters within 16 blocks are driven out. Sneak and use the Lodestone with an empty hand to switch it off.
kultivator.formations.charged: The formation drinks the qi of the shard. Power: %s.
kultivator.formations.full: The formation is already fully charged (%s).
kultivator.formations.on: The Protective Formation is switched on. Power left: %s.
kultivator.formations.off: The Protective Formation is switched off. Its stored power (%s) is kept.
kultivator.formations.no_power: The formation has no power left. Sneak and use the Lodestone while holding an Amethyst Shard to charge it (10 minutes per shard).
kultivator.formations.power_out: Your Protective Formation at %s has used up its power and falls silent. Charge it with Amethyst Shards.
kultivator.formations.broken: Your Protective Formation at %s lost a pillar and falls silent. Put the Crying Obsidian back and switch it on again.
kultivator.formations.destroyed: Your Protective Formation at %s is gone: its Lodestone was removed.
kultivator.formations.server_disabled: Your Protective Formation at %s was switched off: Protective Formations are disabled on this server.
kultivator.formations.list.empty: You have no Protective Formations. Build one: a Lodestone with 4 Crying Obsidian 4 blocks away on the same level, then sneak and use the Lodestone while holding an Amethyst Shard.
kultivator.formations.debug.power: Power of the formation at %1$s set to %2$s.
kultivator.formations.debug.no_lodestone: Look at a Lodestone within 10 blocks.
kultivator.formations.debug.cleared: Removed %s Protective Formation(s) in this dimension. No block was touched.
advancement.kultivator.formation_built.d: Awaken a Protective Formation: a Lodestone with 4 Crying Obsidian pillars 4 blocks away, charged with an Amethyst Shard.
advancement.kultivator.formation_powered: Charge a Protective Formation to its full 2 hours of power.
advancement.kultivator.formation_repelle: Let your Protective Formation drive back 20 monsters.
